files.content:
# Pixel Rock-Paper-Scissors Game

A simple offline browser-based rock-paper-scissors game with a pixel-art inspired theme.

## Features

- Three choice buttons: Rock, Paper, Scissors
- Displays both player and computer choices
- Shows round result (win, lose, draw)
- Tracks player and computer scores
- Reset button to clear scores and start over
- Fully keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive design works from 360px wide

## How to Play

1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. Click one of the choice buttons (Rock, Paper, or Scissors).
3. The computer will randomly choose its move.
4. The round result and updated scores are displayed.
5. Click "Reset Scores" to start a new game.

## Technologies Used

- HTML5
- CSS3 (custom properties, flexbox, responsive design)
- Plain JavaScript (no libraries or frameworks)

## File Structure

- `index.html` — Main game interface
- `style.css` — Styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` — Game logic and event handling
- `README.md` — This file

## Accessibility

- All buttons have `aria-label` attributes.
- Focus states are clearly visible.
- Keyboard navigation works for all interactive elements.
- Font size is at least 16px.

## License

This project is open source and available under the MIT License.
